payload.text: Utilz's 0.1.20 sweep commit 7a6a06a7 drops macos.keychain, and the comment above the block now names the notarytool profile: 0.1.20 had refused the key as unknown (Utilz doctor: 1 failed), and after the edit Utilz doctor reads 15 checks, 0 failed. Left: tell utilz-vc at its next session that notarisation moves to one notarytool keychain profile, macos.notary_profile (default devbin). macos.team picks the signing identity, and is required where the keychain holds more than one Developer ID identity. Before Utilz's next cut, hv runs bin/devbin macos store-creds once on each Mac that cuts, and macos doctor then reads the profile PRESENT. The old keychain items stay where they are, since nothing deletes them.
